Compute v4 = a2[0]*a3[2] + a2[1]*a3[6] + a2[2]*a3[10] + a2[3]*a3[14] (third output component, row 2 of matrix).
Compute v5 = a2[0]*a3[3] + a2[1]*a3[7] + a2[2]*a3[11] + a2[3]*a3[15] (fourth output component, row 3 of matrix).
a1[0] = a2[0]*a3[0] + a2[1]*a3[4] + a2[2]*a3[8] + a2[3]*a3[12] (first output component, row 0 of matrix).
